attachments.origin_landmark: cartilaginous part of the pharyngotympanic tube and the adjoining sphenoid

actions: tenses the tympanic membrane, damping the transmission of loud low-frequency sound

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Pulls the malleus handle medially. With stapedius it forms the acoustic reflex arc, which protects the inner ear from sustained loud noise but is too slow to protect against impulse noise such as gunfire.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Moore KL, Dalley AF, Agur AMR, Clinically Oriented Anatomy, 8th ed.; Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
